title: qairunnisa ka jashne vilaadat hai momino
body:
qairunnisa ka jashne vilaadat hai momino
quraa'n me jiska zikr tahaarat hai momino
<<DIVIDER>>
jisme nabi ki soorato seerat hai momino
wo aalame nisa ki hidaayat hai momino
<<DIVIDER>>
jis dil me fatima ki mohabbat hai momino
wo dil nahi hai asl me jannat hai momino
<<DIVIDER>>
tazeem jiski karte hai paighambare quda
maqsoos syeda ki ye azmat hai momino
<<DIVIDER>>
daryaae noor ka dur ekta hai fatima
ye gouhare yagaanae ismat hai momino
<<DIVIDER>>
tasbeehe fatima se ibaadat qubool hai
ye bhi rasoole paak ki sunnat hai momino
